scope: All three matching source RPCs and the actual server consumer are source/disposable verified: service-only begin/hold, authenticated caller-RLS bound save and immutable commit-proven shared capacity credit. Full225+35 replay and1884 native cases pass with zero failures/skips. Five actual consumer/native-SQL cases use fictional callbacks only. This is not hosted installation, actual provider acceptance or activation.
proposed_unit: One unfinished attached-text extraction reserves one unit in the existing shared pool; source contract only until SQL enforcement is verified. Not a model-request or spending cap.

rpc_contracts.name: begin_bound_document_text_extraction
rpc_contracts.caller: service-role metadata client, after caller-RLS preflight
requirements: Atomically validate actual actor/student/document/extraction/access and both exact revisions/status
Accept only a 64-hex text digest; do not persist pasted text or generated output in metadata
Reserve one unit against the SAME global/account/student pool and serialization fence as existing document work
Keep active/held/uncertain work counted; reject duplicate or competing source starts without reattachment
Refuse when paused, policy is absent/inconsistent, shared capacity is exhausted, or required atomic-save protocol is unavailable
Return one private, exact-source claim only after committed admission; no capability lookup/replay endpoint

receipt.source_text_sha256: exact digest supplied by the trusted caller
receipt.source_revision: exact expected instant, at most six fractional digits
receipt.document_revision: exact expected instant, at most six fractional digits

rpc_contracts.name: save_bound_document_text_review
rpc_contracts.caller: authenticated private caller client; preserve RLS for generated-content writes
requirements: Validate the committed source claim, receipt, actor, text digest and exact source/review
Use the reviewed atomic document/review save and editing-proof locks
Save and settle exactly this operation in one transaction; require actual saved-row/commit proof before releasing capacity
Reject stale/revoked/foreign/held/malformed claims and capability replay; never fall back to unbound save
A lost successful reply must remain completed and must not be regenerated or marked active again
Return only the exact public extraction-row fields; reject internal admission metadata inside the saved result
Require the stored admission_txid to predate the save transaction; validate a real saved-row xmin/revision/content hash and immutable commit proof before settling capacity
Retain the original admission audit; do not delete or reset a reservation to release capacity. Only commit-verified completion may settle it; uncertain provider-backed work remains held.

receipt.extraction: validated same-source needs_review row with a fresh revision

rpc_contracts.name: hold_bound_document_text_extraction
requirements: Mark uncertain active work held without releasing capacity or changing private content
Preserve an already-completed save; no expiry, blind release, synthetic success or retry
If the hold reply is lost/invalid, unfinished work must remain counted

integration_requirements: Use a private actor-scoped authority helper for service admission; never change auth.uid/request JWT session settings to impersonate the actor
No generic begin_document_operation execution grant is reopened
Do not classify provider-backed text generation as DB-only Apply or as an unrelated summary job
Shared capacity totals, pause/drain visibility and trusted reconciliation must include this work
Review all bound source/capability and cross-session races, complete schema replay and source consumer together before deployment
Verify actual provider/Storage behavior only under fresh bounded authorization
verification_scope: Checked-in source plus disposable native PostgreSQL/full schema only; current hosted protocol is not installed.
